def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix label variants - species case
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Fix label variants - island extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Filter out-of-range body_mass_g (2500-6500 grams)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)].copy()
    
    # Exclude missing sex values (do not guess)
    df = df[df['sex'].notna()].copy()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    avg_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return avg_by_sex.to_dict()
